phoneTrace.method: Self-contained esbuild harness with real Taller3D components; three warm interaction runs summarized by median using PerformanceObserver long-task and requestAnimationFrame samples, plus one captured CDP trace per scenario. No app server or network.

scenarios.sheetDrag: Start at medium height, drag the sheet upward 100 CSS px by touch, then allow 430 ms to settle.
scenarios.panelOpen: Start at medium height and touch the Añadir tab; wait for it to become active and 250 ms for rendering.

rulings.benefit: Its pointer-follow spotlight is hover-oriented and adds no useful feedback when browsing the touch sheet.
rulings.cost: The before/after production builds measured 6640 extra uncompressed first-load JS bytes in /3d. Each visible card also mounted pointer-follow effects while the touch sheet has no hover response.
